notes: Single source of truth for packaging forbidden-path lists. fileEntries are file/pattern names (e.g. config.yaml, .env.*): next.config renders them as ./<path> instead of ./<path>/**/*; all other entries are treated as recursive directories. core is forbidden by every consumer; consumers.*.extra is the legal per-consumer difference. Keep this file ASCII-only: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less files with the ANSI codepage, and non-ASCII bytes would corrupt JSON.parse.

nextStandaloneExcludes.notes: next.config.ts outputFileTracingExcludes['*']: core+extra rendered as ./<path>/**/* (fileEntries as ./<path>). runtime is special: Next tracing excludes runtime/ and sync-standalone-assets.mjs then explicitly copies runtime/server-entry.js in.

standaloneSyncPurge.notes: sync-standalone-assets.mjs localOnlyRoots cleanup and assertions (core+extra); a separate dynamic scan additionally removes and asserts every .env* and config.yaml.* variant at the standalone root.

installerPruneCommon.notes: Installer-only forbidden entries shared by the Windows and macOS installers, pruned and asserted at both the payload root and .next/standalone. The JSON uses forward slashes; scripts convert per platform.

windowsInstallerPrune.notes: build-win-installer.ps1 layers: payload-root prune = core + installerPruneCommon.extra + prunePayloadExtra; .next/standalone prune = core + pruneStandaloneExtra; final assertion = core + assertExtra (desktop is covered by core). The whole-payload .env* scan via Get-ChildItem -Filter is independent of this list.

macInstallerPrune.notes: build-mac-installer.sh: PRUNE_RELATIVE_PATHS = core + installerPruneCommon.extra + pruneExtra (pruned and asserted at both the payload root and .next/standalone); findGlobs is the find -name deletion list; assertGlobs is the final assertion list (.env.local is covered by .env.*).

portableWhitelistGuard.notes: The portable build is whitelist-based (whitelist and forbidden lists are different things); this entry only drives windows-portable-payload.test.mjs assertions that the whitelists must not contain these items. config.yaml / .env.local / python-runtime / scripts are explicitly allowed exceptions of the portable build.
